verdict.rationale: Firstbase documents that it can be appointed as your Registered Agent. Its Mailroom virtual mailbox converts mail into viewable high-resolution PDFs. However, the evidence never explicitly ties scanning to registered-agent legal mail or says how service of process is received and delivered digitally. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of digital delivery of service of process and registered-agent legal mail, details on notification and timing, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can use the platform as my registered agent and receive scanned legal mail and service of process digitally

citations.quote: Appoint Firstbase as your Registered Agent — or switch if you already have one — and forget the stress of staying compliant.
We’ll manage all your mail and securely convert them into easily viewable, high-resolution PDFs.
